name: GDGROUP
recent: GDGROUP 于 2026 年 9 月 17 日召开特别股东大会，股东以 100% 票数通过两项拟议收购（Proposed Acquisition 1 与 2）。董事总经理 Lim Swee Kok 与首席运营官 Charles Lim Yong Zhao 于 8 月 19 日至 20 日在场外增持股份。公司于 11 月 19 日公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度的合并业绩。
notable: 股东在特别股东大会上通过两项拟议收购。
董事总经理与首席运营官在场外增持公司股份。

recent_en: GDGROUP held an EGM on 17 Sep 2026 where shareholders passed both Proposed Acquisition 1 and 2 with 100% approval. Managing Director Lim Swee Kok and COO Charles Lim Yong Zhao acquired shares outside closed period on 19-20 Aug. The company released its quarterly consolidated results for the period ended 30 Sep 2026 on 19 Nov.
notable_en: Shareholders approved both proposed acquisitions at the EGM.
The Managing Director and COO acquired shares outside closed period.
